Still a bit jumpy.|Cobb Vanth describing Scott|}} '''Scott''' was a [[human]] [[deputy]] of [[Freetown]] on the planet [[Tatooine]] under the authority of [[Sheriff]] [[Cobb Vanth]]. He was [[Death|killed]] in a [[Showdown in Freetown|duel]] with the [[Duros]] [[mercenary]] [[Cad Bane]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|You want to park your starship, you got to do it out there in the flats.''"
"''I'm looking for Marshal Vanth.''"
"''I don't think you heard what I said.''"
"''I heard you.|Scott and Din Djarin|}} [[File:MandoScott-BoBFCh6.png|thumb|left|300px|Scott confronts Djarin about parking his fighter in the middle of town.]] Around [[9 ABY]], Scott became the deputy of [[Marshal]] [[Cobb Vanth]] of [[Freetown]], a settlement on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Noticing the arrival of a [[Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter|N-1 starfighter]], which landed at the end of the town's main street, he was quick to notify its pilot, the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]], of his infraction, demanding him to park his ship on the flats. As Djarin ignored the request and stated he came to see Vanth, Scott took it personally and hovered his hand over his blaster; he was quickly dismissed, though, by the marshal himself, who went to see his old ally. Vanth described Scott as "jumpy," given that he was hired so recently. Not long after Djarin's eventual departure, Vanth spotted the [[Duros]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] approaching Freetown on foot. The marshal ordered the townsfolk to enter their homes, and Scott stepped outside the local bar and inquired his superior about the matter. Vanth replied he could handle the situation and ordered the deputy back inside. Scott insisted, wanting to help, but was once again ordered to recall inside, and stood by the bar door as the marshal went to [[Showdown in Freetown|face]] Bane, who had been sent by the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. [[File:ScottShot-BoBFCh6.png|thumb|right|300px|Scott was gunned down by Cad Bane.]] When Bane attempted to bribe Vanth, Scott claimed the marshal wouldn't take it, earning a glare from his boss. When Bane threatened Vanth, the pair prepared to draw on each other in a standoff. Scott tensed himself as well, stepping briefly towards Bane and preparing to draw. He then grabbed his [[blaster pistol]], prompting the other two to do the same. However, the Duros was quicker on the draw, wounding Vanth and blasting Scott four times on the chest, killing him. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|What's going on, boss?''"
"''Let me handle this, Deputy.''"
"''I'm not leaving you out here alone.''"
"''Get inside.|Scott and Vanth|}} Scott was a human male with [[Color|light]] skin, brown, greying [[hair]], and grey [[eye]]s. The deputy enforced the laws of Freetown diligently, as shown in his brief interaction with Din Djarin over the parking of his ship. As stated by Cobb Vanth, Scott was "a bit jumpy," being newly recruited to his position and eager to show his authority; he had a good heart, but lacked situational awareness. These two traits were the key to his demise, as he stepped in to try and help the Marshal in his conflict with Cad Bane instead of allowing Vanth to handle the situation like his superior ordered him to. Ultimately his actions made the situation worse, as his behavior distracted Vanth allowing Bane to shoot both of them, one fatally. ==Behind the scenes== Scott was introduced in "[[Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger]]," the sixth episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[February 2]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-february-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in February 2022}} He was portrayed by [[JJ Dashnaw]]. Though not named in the episode, Scott was identified in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-chapter-6-highlights|text=The Best of ''The Book of Boba Fett'': 5 Highlights from "Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger"}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|freetown-mos-pelgo|Freetown (Mos Pelgo)}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Scott (Deputy) |es=Scott |ja=スコット |ka=სკოტი |nl=Scott }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Police]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
